set.body: User authorized the next two steps: documentation journey with executable examples/generated API docs, and tagged developer preview. Scope: mdBook guides plus Rustdoc on GitHub Pages, prerelease versions/metadata, release notes and bounded source-bound benchmark evidence. Preserve scientific algorithms, synthetic-only inputs and mixed licenses; crates.io remains disabled. Acceptance: examples, docs/link checks, three-platform CI, deployed-site verification and release tag/assets bound to qualified SHA.
set.title: Publish task-oriented guides and v0.1.0-alpha.1 developer preview
